The AKS cluster module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks enables managed Azure AD (role_based_access_control.azure_active_directory.managed = true), which requires the AAD-V2 preview feature to be registered with Microsoft.ContainerService. The null_resource register_aks_msi_preview_feature performs that registration (and can take ~30 minutes to complete), but the cluster has no dependency on it, so the cluster can be created before the feature registration finishes and fail. Add `depends_on = [null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature]` to the cluster.

The isolated blob module :module.storage_account_blobs only carries an implicit dependency on the storage account name (module.storage_accounts:output.name); nothing orders it after the target blob container is created by module.storage_accounts:module.container. Terraform cannot infer this ordering because storage_container_name is a plain string value, and azurerm_storage_blob creation will fail if the container does not yet exist.

The explicit depends_on of module.azuread_applications:resource.null_resource.grant_admin_consent on module.azuread_applications:resource.azuread_service_principal.app is redundant: the provisioner already references azuread_service_principal.app.id in its environment block (principalId), establishing the same ordering implicitly.

The explicit depends_on of :resource.azurerm_virtual_hub_connection.vhub_connection on :module.virtual_wans is redundant: the resource already references module.virtual_wans[each.value.vhub.virtual_wan_key].virtual_hubs[...].id via the virtual_hub_id attribute (module.virtual_wans:output.virtual_hubs), which already forces the virtual WAN/hubs to be created first.

The explicit depends_on of module.app_service_environments:data.external.ase_ilb_ip on module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase is redundant: the program argument already embeds lookup(azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, "id"), which establishes the dependency on the ASE deployment implicitly.

The explicit depends_on of module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_private_dns_a_record.a_records on module.app_service_environments:resource.azurerm_template_deployment.ase is redundant: the records attribute references data.external.ase_ilb_ip.result, which itself depends on the ASE deployment (implicitly and explicitly), so the ordering is already transitively guaranteed.

The explicit depends_on of module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy on module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault is redundant: recovery_vault_name = azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name already establishes the dependency implicitly.

The explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway on module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant: virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id already establishes the dependency implicitly.

The explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway on module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant: virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id already establishes the dependency implicitly.

The explicit depends_on of module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway on module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub is redundant: virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id already establishes the dependency implicitly.
